name: Problem statement, light-to-dark rebuttal cut
looks: On a light field a three-line headline stacks in, each line graying the one before it, landing on a stat number that drops in bold under a small caption. It hard-cuts to a full black field holding the brand mark static in the centre, and a short rebuttal line fades in white below it.
build: List-stack-reveal for the headline (0.3s per line, power2.out, prior lines to ~45% opacity); the stat number pops in on its own beat, scale 0.9->1. A hard cut (no crossfade) swaps the whole field to the dark palette; the mark is a static SVG/DOM icon, and the rebuttal line fades/slides up 8px over about 0.3s.
sound: A soft tick per line, a slightly louder hit on the stat, then a flat beat of silence into the cut before the rebuttal's tick.
prompt: Open on a plain field with a short headline that stacks in line by line, each earlier line dimming as the next lands, finishing on one bold stat that proves the problem is real. Hard-cut to the inverse palette, hold the brand mark static and alone, and fade in a short one-line rebuttal beneath it.
